title: Disk Health (SMART)
description: smartmontools 기반 디스크 건강 상태 — github: mirror-disk-health

list.name: device
list.label: SMART 장치
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "smart_device" WITH KEY = "device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "smart_device" WITH KEY = "device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/

list.name: iodev
list.label: I/O 장치
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "diskio" WITH KEY = "name" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "diskio" WITH KEY = "name" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/

panels.title: 개요 — 선택 기간 내 마지막 상태
디스크
panels.description: SMART 를 읽은 물리 디스크 수

targets.query: SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("status_code") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "serial")

panels.title: 위험
panels.description: SMART FAILED, 보류/복구불가 섹터, NVMe critical warning·미디어 에러, 셀프테스트 실패 등

targets.query: SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("status_code") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "serial") WHERE "last" = 2

panels.title: 경고
panels.description: 재할당 섹터, CRC 에러, 고온, 수명 사용률 기준 초과 등

targets.query: SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("status_code") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "serial") WHERE "last" = 1
SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("status_code") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "serial") WHERE "last" = 0
SELECT max("last") FROM (SELECT last("temperature_c") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "serial")

panels.title: 스핀다운
panels.description: 최근 15분 동안 대기 상태라 SMART 조회를 건너뛴 디스크 (SKIP_STANDBY=yes)

targets.query: SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("standby") FROM "disk_health_standby" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND time > now() - 15m GROUP BY "host", "device")

panels.title: 수집 오류
panels.description: 최근 15분 동안 smartctl 이 열지 못한 장치 — 아래 '수집기' 행 참고

targets.query: SELECT count("last") FROM (SELECT last("exit_status") FROM "disk_health_error" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND time > now() - 15m GROUP BY "host", "device")

panels.title: RAID/ZFS 이상
panels.description: ZFS: ONLINE 이 아닌 vdev 수

targets.query: SELECT sum("last") FROM (SELECT last("vdevs_not_online") FROM "zfs_pool" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND time > now() - 15m GROUP BY "host", "pool")
SELECT sum("last") FROM (SELECT last("DisksFailed") FROM "mdstat" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND time > now() - 15m GROUP BY "host", "Name")

panels.title: 디스크 상태 요약
panels.description: 상태: 0 정상 / 1 경고 / 2 위험. 각 값은 선택 기간 내 마지막 수집값.

targets.query: SELECT last("status_code") AS "상태", last("status_reason") AS "사유", last("temperature_c") AS "온도", last("power_on_hours") AS "가동시간", last("reallocated_sectors") AS "재할당", last("pending_sectors") AS "보류섹터", last("offline_uncorrectable") AS "복구불가", last("reported_uncorrect") AS "UNC", last("udma_crc_errors") AS "CRC", last("media_errors") AS "미디어에러", last("grown_defects") AS "결함(SAS)", last("life_used_percent") AS "수명사용", last("available_spare") AS "예비공간", last("last_selftest_passed") AS "셀프테스트", last("last_selftest_age_hours") AS "테스트경과", last("capacity_bytes") AS "용량", last("firmware") AS "펌웨어" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "model", "serial", "kind"
SELECT mean("temperature_c") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

panels.title: 재할당 섹터 (ATA #5)
panels.description: 불량으로 판정돼 예비 영역으로 옮겨진 섹터. 꾸준히 늘면 교체.

targets.query: SELECT max("reallocated_sectors") AS "realloc" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

panels.title: 보류 / 복구불가 섹터 (ATA #197/#198)
panels.description: 읽기 실패 후 재할당 대기 중인 섹터. 0 이 아니면 데이터 손상 위험.

targets.query: SELECT max("pending_sectors") AS "pending", max("offline_uncorrectable") AS "offline_unc" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

panels.title: CRC / UNC (ATA #199/#187)
panels.description: CRC 는 케이블/백플레인 문제, UNC 는 ECC 로 복구 못한 읽기 에러.

targets.query: SELECT max("udma_crc_errors") AS "crc", max("reported_uncorrect") AS "unc" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

SELECT max("media_errors") AS "media_err", max("critical_warning") AS "crit_warn" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

SELECT max("grown_defects") AS "grown", max("read_uncorrected") AS "read_unc", max("write_uncorrected") AS "write_unc" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

panels.title: 선택 기간 동안 증가한 카운터
panels.description: spread = 기간 내 최대 - 최소. 0 이 아니면 해당 기간에 새로 발생한 것.

targets.query: SELECT spread("reallocated_sectors") AS "재할당", spread("pending_sectors") AS "보류섹터", spread("udma_crc_errors") AS "CRC", spread("reported_uncorrect") AS "UNC", spread("media_errors") AS "미디어에러", spread("grown_defects") AS "결함(SAS)", spread("error_log_count") AS "에러로그" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "model"

panels.title: 수명 사용률
panels.description: NVMe Percentage Used / ATA Device Statistics / 벤더 SMART 속성 기준. 100% = 보증 TBW 도달.

targets.query: SELECT last("life_used_percent") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "model"

panels.title: 일별 기록량 (최근 30일)
panels.description: NVMe data units written / ATA Logical Sectors Written / SAS 쓰기 처리량의 일별 증가분

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("bytes_written")) FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "host", "device" fill(none)
SELECT min("available_spare") FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND "kind" = 'nvme' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

SELECT max("unsafe_shutdowns") AS "unsafe", max("power_cycles") AS "cycles" FROM "smart_device" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "device" fill(none)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("reads"), 1s) AS "read", non_negative_derivative(max("writes"), 1s) AS "write" FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "name" =~ /^$iodev$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "name" fill(none)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("read_bytes"), 1s) AS "read", non_negative_derivative(max("write_bytes"), 1s) AS "write" FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "name" =~ /^$iodev$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "name" fill(none)

panels.title: 사용률 (%util)
panels.description: io_time(ms)/초 ÷ 10. iostat 의 %util 과 같은 의미 (NVMe/RAID 는 100% 여도 여유가 있을 수 있음)

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("io_time"), 1s) / 10 FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "name" =~ /^$iodev$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "name" fill(none)

SELECT ("rt" + "wt") / ("r" + "w") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("read_time")) AS "rt", non_negative_derivative(max("write_time")) AS "wt", non_negative_derivative(max("reads")) AS "r", non_negative_derivative(max("writes")) AS "w" FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "name" =~ /^$iodev$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "name") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "name"

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("weighted_io_time"), 1s) / 1000 FROM "diskio" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "name" =~ /^$iodev$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "name" fill(none)
SELECT last("used_percent") FROM "disk" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "path"
SELECT mean("used") FROM "disk" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host", "path" fill(none)

SELECT last("DisksTotal") AS "전체", last("DisksActive") AS "활성", last("DisksFailed") AS "실패", last("DisksDown") AS "다운", last("DisksSpare") AS "스페어", last("BlocksSyncedPct") AS "동기화진행" FROM "mdstat" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "Name", "ActivityState", "Devices"

SELECT last("status_code") AS "상태", last("health") AS "health", last("capacity_percent") AS "사용률", last("fragmentation_percent") AS "단편화", last("read_errors") AS "READ", last("write_errors") AS "WRITE", last("checksum_errors") AS "CKSUM", last("vdevs_not_online") AS "비정상vdev", last("resilver_in_progress") AS "리실버", last("last_scrub") AS "마지막 스크럽" FROM "zfs_pool" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "pool"

panels.title: ATA SMART 속성 원본
panels.description: value/worst 가 thresh 이하로 내려가면 해당 속성 실패

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "value", last("worst") AS "worst", last("thresh") AS "thresh", last("raw") AS "raw", last("prefailure") AS "prefail", last("failing_now") AS "failing" FROM "smart_attribute" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "device" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host", "device", "model", "attr_id", "attr_name"
SELECT max("duration_ms") FROM "disk_health_collector" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: 수집 오류 (최근 1시간)
panels.description: 스캔은 되지만 열리지 않는 장치. RAID 뒤 디스크면 EXTRA_DEVICES 설정

targets.query: SELECT last("exit_status") AS "exit", last("message") AS "message" FROM "disk_health_error" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND time > now() - 1h GROUP BY "host", "device"

SELECT last("smartctl_version") AS "smartctl", last("collector_version") AS "collector", last("devices_ok") AS "정상조회", last("devices_standby") AS "대기", last("devices_error") AS "오류" FROM "disk_health_collector" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "host"
